module: Editor API module for "sketches" (drawings in the world). In this version it is only a shell: initialize(editor) adds three functions (createSketch, deleteSketch, getSketches) to the editor object whose body is empty (TODO comment). The planned hooks are listed in a comment: onEditorSketchCreated, onEditorSketchDelete, onEditorSketchChanged.
notes: The three functions do nothing and return nil: they are still to be implemented (TODO in the code).
The onEditorSketchCreated/Delete/Changed hooks are only mentioned in a comment, nothing triggers them in this file.

initialize.desc: Registers createSketch, deleteSketch and getSketches on the editor object passed as an argument. Called by the editor API loader.

editorInstance.desc: Global editor object of the editor on which the functions are added.

editor.desc: Editor object of the editor, enriched by initialize. All these methods are empty stubs.

createSketch.desc: Planned to create a sketch. Empty body (TODO).

deleteSketch.desc: Planned to delete a sketch. Empty body (TODO).

sketchObjectId.desc: Sketch object id (inferred from the name).

getSketches.desc: Planned to list the sketches. Empty body (TODO), returns nil.
